title: Holy Angel University grad gets top score in aeronautical engineers licensure exam
summary: A graduate of Holy Angel University scored the highest in the recent computer-based licensure examination for aeronautical engineers, the Professional Regulation Commission said.

blocks.text: A graduate of Holy Angel University scored the highest grade in the recent computer-based licensure examination for aeronautical engineers, the Professional Regulation Commission said.
According to the PRC, 558 test takers out of 764 passed the exam, given by the Board of Aeronautical Engineering in Metro Manila, Cagayan de Oro, Cebu, Davao, Legazpi, Lucena, Pampanga and Rosales.

Holy Angel's Franco Andrei Nikki Balatbat Dizon achieved the top score of 92.65%, while the best-performing school with 50 or more test takers is WCC Aeronautical and Technical College-North Manila, with 51 of 56 examinees passing.
